subtitle: Lesson 92 · Transactions, Locking, and Isolation Levels

eyebrow: Session A — change made, not yet committed
caption: The change exists only inside Session A's open transaction so far.

eyebrow: Session B — reads the in-flight change
caption: READ UNCOMMITTED skips honoring Session A's lock entirely.

eyebrow: Session A rolls back -- the value never existed
code:
-- SESSION A, continued
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
-- The price change never happened.
-- Session B's 9999.00 has no committed history behind it.
caption: That's the dirty read: a value that, in the end, never really existed.

eyebrow: The same risk, as a table hint
caption: WITH (NOLOCK) has the exact same dirty-read-permitting effect, per query.

subtitle: When a committed change moves under you mid-transaction.
